sentences.text: 2. Heard learned advocate Mr. Tejas P. Satta for the NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/273/2025 ORDER DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined applicants and learned advocate Ms. Devanshi K. Patel, AGP for respondent No.1.
Though served, no one is present for respondent No.2.
3. Learned advocate for the applicants has submitted that the applicants have good case on merits as well as on law.
It is further submitted that applicants are poor and mainly dependent on agricultural income and they had to collect necessary papers and arrange Court fees and other expenses.
It is further submitted that delay may be condoned as there is no intentional delay on the part of the applicants.
3.1 It is further submitted that the present applicants are unaware of the provisions of law, which could permit them to file appeal, which is a statutory right.

It is further submitted that in view of the settled principles of law in the decision of Hon'ble Apex Court in case of K. Subbarayadu NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/273/2025 ORDER DATED: 10/06/2025 undefined and others Vs. The Special Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition) reported in 2017(12) SCC 840 and would submit that considering the law laid down in aforementioned case, the applicants are not claiming their right for the interest upon the enhanced compensation, if any, for the delay period, if appellants succeeds in the respective First Appeals.

entities.text: K. Subbarayadu NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/273/2025 ORDER DATED:
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the submissions canvassed by the learned advocates for the respective parties and contentions raised in the application, it is needless to observe that in catena of decisions, the view taken by the Hon'ble Supreme Court is, while deciding an application for condonation of delay, the liberal and justice orientated approach needs to be adopted so that the substantive rights of the parties are not defeated only on the ground of delay.
To meet with the equity, delay can be condoned.
There is no intentional delay on the part of the applicants.
The delay has sufficiently been explained.

Hence, the delay is condoned NEUTRAL CITATION C/CA/273/2025 ORDER DATED:
10/06/2025 undefined subject to condition that the claimant/s shall not claim interest upon enhanced compensation, if any, for the period of delay, if succeeds the appeal.
5. With these observations and directions, the present Civil Applications stand allowed.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
